context.transcript:
Someone from the movie studio called about getting a copy of the script.
Are we finished with the final draft?
No, I'm afraid some of the scenes have to be rewritten.
Well, I'm concerned that'll cause a delay in production if it takes much longer.
When do you think the final draft will be ready?
I don't know.
I've scheduled a meeting with the writers today to check on their progress.
I'll forward you the details so you can join.

一位电影制片厂的人打电话来，说要拿到剧本的副本。

你觉得最终稿什么时候能准备好？
我不知道。
我今天安排了一个与编剧们的会议来了解他们的进展。
我会把细节转发给你，这样你可以参加。
